items.known: CKV_AWS_161 Ensure RDS database has IAM authentication enabled (resource aws_db_instance.postgresql)
items.remediation: Add `iam_database_authentication_enabled = true` to the `aws_db_instance.postgresql` resource block and update application connection strings to use IAM token-based authentication.

scores.reason: Correct attribute and value for aws_db_instance: set iam_database_authentication_enabled = true.
